subject: Re: SOW_Disney_Zion
body:
Subject: Exciting Next Steps Together

Hi Mauricio,

Thank you once again for the opportunity to collaborate on the Disney project. I truly appreciated the partnership we built and the open communication we shared throughout the process.

As we look ahead, I wanted to share three tailored business ideas that I believe could create significant value for both Zion Tech Group and Ziontechgroup:

1. **Managed AI Support Automation** — We can deploy our AI agents to manage Tier-1 and Tier-2 tickets, significantly reducing response times by over 60%. This would streamline your operations while allowing your specialists to focus on more complex issues. We could run this as a co-branded service, leveraging your client relationships alongside our AI delivery.

2. **AI Readiness & Cost-Optimization Assessments** — Building on our previous discussions, we can package the audit framework into a repeatable, co-branded offering. This would enable you to lead with prospects while we handle the technical depth. We can agree on a revenue split of 50/50 on the net margin, ensuring mutual benefits.

3. **Hybrid-Cloud Migration + AI Ops Pilot** — I propose a 30-day pilot that utilizes your current environment along with our platform. This pilot would demonstrate measurable reductions in Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) and cloud cost savings. Following the pilot, we can transition into a Master Services Agreement or Statement of Work with pre-agreed pricing.

I’m eager to move this forward efficiently. We can discuss the details further via email, or if you prefer, we can finalize the commercial terms during a brief call. Here’s my Calendly link to schedule a time that works for you: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup.

Additionally, I encourage you to explore the free services and tools available on our website, which your team can start using right away: https://ziontechgroup.com.

Which of these three ideas resonates most with you? I’d be happy to send over a one-page term sheet for whichever path you prefer.

Looking forward to your thoughts!

Best regards,  
Kleber Garcia Alcatrão  
CEO, Zion Tech Group  
kleber@ziontechgroup.com  
+1 302 464 0950  
https://ziontechgroup.com
